name: Speusippus
bio: Speusippus was the nephew of Plato and his successor as head of the Academy at Athens. The Greek Anthology ascribes to him a short epitaph on Plato.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 31.

poems.title: Book XVI, 31
poems.author: Speusippus
poems.text: The earth holds in its bosom this, the body of Plato, but his soul is equal in rank to the blessed gods.
